focus: Write for the IT (information technology) staffing industry in the United States: what is changing in hiring for software, cloud, data, AI, cybersecurity, network and IT support roles, and what it means for employers planning their technology teams and for IT professionals planning their next role. Cover contract, contract-to-hire, direct-hire and temporary IT work, skills in demand, pay and workforce planning, using the main source's own specific story. Stay on technology jobs and technology teams.
